issues.title: There is no canonical nonpromotable directional repair surface
issues.defect: Current outputs include exclusions/audits but no authoritative one-row-per-applicable-candidate surface that preserves identity, provenance, terminal promotability outcome, and exact repair reason while keeping atoms clean.
issues.evidence: Current candidate/exclusion/blocked/coverage artifacts distribute this information across multiple files.
issues.consequence: Repair debt can be lost, double-counted, or classified inconsistently by downstream stages.
issues.required: Add canonical `directional_candidate_adjudication` / `nonpromotable_directional_candidates` output, keyed at candidate identity, with terminal outcome and reason vocabulary.
tests: Applicable candidates partition exactly into promotable atoms + nonpromotable candidates + not-applicable outside denominator.

issues.title: Distribution completeness cannot distinguish selection partiality from repair debt
issues.defect: Current coverage does not canonically carry selected substantive mass, promotable mass, unresolved adjudication mass, and neutral represented mass as separate conserved quantities, nor does it distinguish intentionally partial selected response surfaces from unresolved applicable evidence.
issues.evidence: Existing V552 has accepted selected-category partial behavior; new repair debt is a different phenomenon.
issues.consequence: V552 can silently normalize away unresolved mass or mistake lawful selected-surface partiality for a defect.
issues.required: Emit distribution coverage with two orthogonal statuses (`selected_surface_status`, `directional_adjudication_status`), weighted/unweighted counts/mass, and hard conservation checks.
tests: Applicable rows = promotable + nonpromotable at exact distribution grain.
Promotable + unresolved mass ≤ selected substantive mass; equality when classifiable.
Neutral counts represented mass but zero pressure.

issues.title: V551 atom contract leaks V552 pressure decisions upstream
issues.defect: V551 embeds V552-specific pressure eligibility/status/ineligibility reason in atoms and even includes those fields in measurement/atom contract hashes.
issues.consequence: V551 and V552 maintain competing state machines; valid neutral relation evidence is marked pressure-ineligible upstream and can be misread downstream.
issues.required: V551 should emit valid relation evidence + canonical signed projection + coverage/review state only. V552 alone decides operation-local pressure participation. Retire V552-specific fields from authoritative V551 contract (compatibility-only if temporarily needed).
tests: Neutral atom remains valid relation evidence without a V551-authored V552 eligibility verdict.

issues.title: V551 has too many overlapping state artifacts for the same adjudication
issues.defect: Pressure-component audit, lineage audit, exclusion audit, blocked-signal audit, eligible-bridge coverage, candidate bridge, review surface and summaries overlap in describing why rows did or did not become atoms. Several have no meaningful external runtime consumer.
issues.evidence: Compiler writes numerous parallel CSV/parquet/schema artifacts from the same run.
issues.consequence: Parallel truth surfaces can disagree and force future code to reconstruct a state machine from artifacts rather than one terminal adjudication.
issues.required: Reduce authoritative V551 surfaces to candidate adjudication/repair, clean atoms, distribution coverage, and run manifest. Derive diagnostics/compatibility views from those where real consumers remain.
tests: No duplicated authoritative terminal disposition for the same candidate identity.

issues.title: V551 compile modes can select different semantic universes
issues.defect: CLI supports `legacy_full_bridge`, `optimized_candidate_bridge`, and `compare`; default is legacy while smoke invokes optimized. The “optimization” chooses which rows are passed to atom compilation.
issues.consequence: Performance mode can alter semantic visibility; operator invocation becomes part of evidence semantics.
issues.required: Use one semantic candidate/adjudication algorithm. Optimization may change indexing/vectorization only, never the evidence universe. Remove or demote semantic mode switch after migration.
tests: Legacy/optimized execution paths produce identical candidate IDs by construction or only one path remains.

issues.title: Auxiliary-input provenance hashes are not tied to the bridge that actually produced the semantics
issues.defect: Compiler reads/hashes the QUC, source-structure audit and response-option map, but the atom builder primarily trusts pre-enriched bridge fields and does not prove that the supplied auxiliary artifacts are the exact producer inputs for those bridge fields.
issues.evidence: Compiler computes `_frame_hash` values and passes them; current builder accepts them as provenance without a producer-declared lineage equality check.
issues.consequence: Unrelated auxiliary files can be stamped into atom provenance without proving causal lineage (“provenance theater”).
issues.required: Either verify supplied artifact hashes against V550 producer manifest/bridge contract, or stop presenting them as active semantic inputs. Producer-declared hashes must be the expected values.
tests: Substitute unrelated QUC/response map must fail lineage verification.

issues.title: `question_use_contract_hash` changes grain/meaning between V550 and V551
issues.defect: In V550 the field denotes a specific question-use contract row hash; V551 overwrites/uses the same field name for a whole QUC DataFrame/artifact hash.
issues.evidence: Observed in current V550/V551 provenance construction during hostile pass.
issues.consequence: Downstream cannot know whether the hash identifies governing row semantics or the entire artifact; lineage comparisons become ambiguous.
issues.required: Split into explicit `question_use_contract_row_hash` and `question_use_contract_artifact_hash`, preserve both, and verify artifact hash against producer declaration.
tests: Row hash stable for same question contract; artifact hash changes only with artifact bytes.

issues.title: New V551 contract must reject old/new producer-consumer mixing
issues.affected: V551 schema/compiler contract and V551J/V552 readers
issues.defect: The promotability/coverage migration changes authoritative fields, hashes and empty-run semantics. Existing consumers are version-pinned inconsistently and can otherwise ingest artifacts whose fields have the same names but different semantics.
issues.evidence: Current V551 atom schema version v2.1; V551J v2.2.3; V552 v2.1.4.
issues.consequence: Silent contract mixing can produce apparently valid but semantically incoherent downstream outputs.
issues.required: Issue an explicit new V551 compiler/schema contract version; downstream readers validate exact supported versions and producer-declared artifact hashes.
tests: Old V551 artifacts rejected by new V551J/V552 unless explicit compatibility adapter used.
